{{velocity output="false"}} ## The identifiers of the item types and of the interval units, in display order. #set ($purgeTypes = ['deletedDocuments', 'deletedAttachments']) #set ($purgeUnits = ['days', 'weeks', 'months', 'years']) #set ($purgeStatuses = ['success', 'partial', 'failed', 'interrupted']) #set ($purgeModes = ['inherit', 'enabled', 'disabled']) ## Load the default settings: $purgeDefaults holds the settings of each item type, by item type identifier, and ## $purgeMaxHistoryEntries the history size. #macro (loadPurgeDefaults) #set ($purgeGlobalSettings = $services.adminToolsAutoPurge.getDefaultSettings()) #set ($purgeDefaults = {}) #foreach ($entry in $purgeGlobalSettings.typeSettings.entrySet()) #set ($discard = $purgeDefaults.put($entry.key.id, $entry.value)) #end #set ($purgeMaxHistoryEntries = $purgeGlobalSettings.maxHistoryEntries) #end ## Get the labels of the settings of an item type. It sets $purgeDefaultLabel to the default limit, e.g. "1 month" or ## "disabled", and, when the settings of a wiki are given, $purgePolicyLabel to what applies to the wiki, e.g. ## "Default · 1 month", "Custom · 7 days" or "Disabled". #macro (getPurgeLabels $defaultSettings $wikiSettings) #if ($defaultSettings.mode.id == 'enabled') #getPurgeIntervalLabel($defaultSettings) #set ($purgeDefaultLabel = $purgeIntervalLabel) #else #set ($purgeDefaultLabel = $services.localization.render('adminTools.purge.policy.disabled.lower')) #end #if ($wikiSettings.mode.id == 'enabled') #getPurgeIntervalLabel($wikiSettings) #set ($purgePolicyLabel = $services.localization.render('adminTools.purge.policy.custom', [$purgeIntervalLabel])) #elseif ($wikiSettings.mode.id == 'disabled') #set ($purgePolicyLabel = $services.localization.render('adminTools.purge.policy.disabled')) #else #set ($purgePolicyLabel = $services.localization.render('adminTools.purge.policy.default', [$purgeDefaultLabel])) #end #end ## Set $purgeIntervalLabel to the limit of enabled settings, e.g. "1 month", or to a warning if the stored interval or ## unit is missing, which can only come from a manual edit. #macro (getPurgeIntervalLabel $settings) #if ($settings.interval.isPresent() && $settings.unit.isPresent()) #set ($purgeIntervalLabel = $services.localization.render("adminTools.purge.interval.${settings.unit.get().id}", [$settings.interval.get()])) #else #set ($purgeIntervalLabel = $services.localization.render('adminTools.purge.interval.invalid')) #end #end ## The defaults shown on the purge page, for each item type and for the history size. #macro (getPurgeDefaultsSummary) #set ($purgeDefaultsSummary = {}) #foreach ($type in $purgeTypes) #getPurgeLabels($purgeDefaults.get($type) $NULL) #if ($purgeDefaults.get($type).mode.id == 'enabled') #set ($discard = $purgeDefaultsSummary.put($type, $services.localization.render('adminTools.purge.defaults.enabled', [$purgeDefaultLabel]))) #else #set ($discard = $purgeDefaultsSummary.put($type, $services.localization.render('adminTools.purge.defaults.disabled'))) #end #end #set ($discard = $purgeDefaultsSummary.put('maxHistoryEntries', $services.localization.render('adminTools.purge.defaults.historySize', [$purgeMaxHistoryEntries]))) #end ## The fields of the interval of an item type, e.g. "Keep for [n] [unit]", with the label of the given key. The ## smallest interval is 1 for the settings, and 0 for a manual purge, which then purges every deleted item. #macro (purgeIntervalFields $idPrefix $type $settings $disabled $labelKey $min) ## Months is selected when there is no stored unit. #set ($selectedUnit = 'months') #set ($interval = '') #if ($settings) #if ($settings.unit.isPresent()) #set ($selectedUnit = $settings.unit.get().id) #end #if ($settings.interval.isPresent()) #set ($interval = $settings.interval.get()) #end #end #end ## The modal header, with its title. #macro (purgeModalHeader $id $titleKey)
$escapetool.xml($services.localization.render($titleKey))

#end ## Get the options of a list filter of a LiveData, as $purgeListOptions: one option for each value, labelled by the ## translation of the key prefix followed by the value. #macro (getPurgeListOptions $values $keyPrefix) #set ($purgeListOptions = []) #foreach ($value in $values) #set ($discard = $purgeListOptions.add({'value': $value, 'label': $services.localization.render("${keyPrefix}${value}")})) #end #end ## Output a LiveData from its configuration, as the HTML the liveData macro would produce. The macro is not used, ## since its JSON content is wiki syntax: a translated filter label holding "{{/liveData}}" would close the macro and ## let the rest of the label run as wiki syntax. As an HTML attribute, the configuration is escaped like the rest of ## the page, and the LiveData can be placed inside HTML, e.g. in a modal. This is what #livetable_liveData does too. #macro (purgeLiveData $config) #set ($discard = $xwiki.jsfx.use('uicomponents/widgets/liveData.js', {'forceSkinAction': true})) ## Add the default values, as the macro does. #set ($purgeLiveDataJSON = $services.liveData.effectiveConfig($jsontool.serialize($config))) #if ($purgeLiveDataJSON) ## The HTML of the cells is trusted when the author of the page can write scripts, as with the macro.
#else

#end #end ## The LiveData of the wikis, with their settings, their newest purge and their actions. #macro (purgeWikisLiveData) #getPurgeListOptions($purgeModes 'adminTools.purge.mode.') #set ($modeOptions = $purgeListOptions) #set ($wikiProperties = [{'id': 'wikiName', 'displayer': 'text'}]) ## The table is an overview of the configuration: the column of an item type filters the wikis by their own ## configuration of it (default, custom or disabled). #foreach ($type in $purgeTypes) #set ($discard = $wikiProperties.add({'id': $type, 'displayer': 'html', 'sortable': false, 'filter': {'id': 'list', 'options': $modeOptions}})) #end #set ($discard = $wikiProperties.add({'id': 'actions', 'displayer': 'html', 'sortable': false, 'filterable': false})) #set ($wikiPropertyIds = []) #foreach ($property in $wikiProperties) #set ($discard = $wikiPropertyIds.add($property.id)) #end #set ($wikisConfig = { 'id': 'purgeWikis', 'query': { 'properties': $wikiPropertyIds, 'source': { 'id': 'liveTable', 'resultPage': 'AdminTools.Purge.Code.PurgeJSON', 'translationPrefix': 'adminTools.purge.wikis.header.' }, 'sort': [{'property': 'wikiName', 'descending': false}] }, 'meta': { 'propertyDescriptors': $wikiProperties, 'entryDescriptor': {'idProperty': 'wikiId'} } }) #purgeLiveData($wikisConfig) #end ## The modal listing the purge history of a wiki. The JavaScript sets the wiki of the LiveData before showing it. #macro (purgeHistoryModal) #getPurgeListOptions($purgeTypes 'adminTools.purge.type.') #set ($typeOptions = $purgeListOptions) #getPurgeListOptions($purgeStatuses 'AdminTools.Purge.Code.HistoryClass_status_') #set ($statusOptions = $purgeListOptions) #getPurgeListOptions(['scheduled', 'manual'] 'adminTools.purge.history.trigger.') #set ($triggerOptions = $purgeListOptions) #set ($historyConfig = { 'id': 'purgeHistory', 'query': { 'properties': ['date', 'type', 'status', 'removedCount', 'failedCount', 'trigger', 'actions'], 'source': { 'id': 'liveTable', 'resultPage': 'AdminTools.Purge.Code.PurgeJSON', 'translationPrefix': 'adminTools.purge.history.header.', 'data': 'history', 'wikiId': '' }, 'sort': [{'property': 'date', 'descending': true}], 'limit': 10 }, 'meta': { 'propertyDescriptors': [ {'id': 'date', 'displayer': 'text', 'filterable': false}, {'id': 'type', 'displayer': 'text', 'sortable': false, 'filter': {'id': 'list', 'options': $typeOptions}}, {'id': 'status', 'displayer': 'html', 'sortable': false, 'filter': {'id': 'list', 'options': $statusOptions}}, {'id': 'removedCount', 'displayer': 'text', 'sortable': false, 'filterable': false}, {'id': 'failedCount', 'displayer': 'text', 'sortable': false, 'filterable': false}, {'id': 'trigger', 'displayer': 'text', 'sortable': false, 'filter': {'id': 'list', 'options': $triggerOptions}}, {'id': 'actions', 'displayer': 'html', 'sortable': false, 'filterable': false} ], 'entryDescriptor': {'idProperty': 'id'} } })
